faqs.question: How do I write a Navratri invitation message in Hindi?
faqs.answer: Name the event (chowki, jagran, kanya pujan), the day and date, a start time, the address with a landmark, and ask for a reply. Keep the WhatsApp version under about 40 words so it fits one phone screen, and save the formal सादर आमंत्रण wording for a printed card.

faqs.question: Should I use aap or tum in a Navratri invitation?
faqs.answer: Use आप for elders, neighbours and any family group, and तुम only for friends, siblings and cousins your own age. McGregor's Hindi dictionary glosses तुम as the reduced honorific grade of "you", so it reads casual to an elder.

faqs.question: What is the difference between saadar aamantran and saprem nimantran?
faqs.answer: सादर means "respectful", so सादर आमंत्रण suits a formal card for elders and neighbours. सप्रेम means "with love" (स + प्रेम) and suits close family; it is not a dictionary headword, and आमंत्रण and निमंत्रण both mean invitation.

faqs.question: What is the format of a Navratri invitation card in Hindi?
faqs.answer: Start with ॥ जय माता दी ॥, then one line naming the event and the host's home, then "आप सपरिवार सादर आमंत्रित हैं". Follow with दिनांक, समय and स्थान on separate lines and sign off with विनीत and the family name.

faqs.question: How do I invite people to a Mata ki Chowki on WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Send one short Hindi message with the date, the evening start time, the address and a request for your headcount, because a chowki usually ends in a bhandara. Add the printed card as an image for elders who prefer it.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a jagran and a chowki?
faqs.answer: A chowki is an evening of bhajans and aarti before the Goddess's platform-altar; a jagran is a vigil that runs through the night. A jagran invitation should say when it starts and which aarti guests can leave after.

faqs.question: When is kanya pujan in 2026, Ashtami or Navami?
faqs.answer: In North India, Durga Ashtami and Maha Navami both fall on Monday 19 October 2026 (Drik Panchang, New Delhi), so families of either custom share one date. In 2027 they split: Ashtami on Thursday 7 October and Navami on Friday 8 October.

faqs.question: Who should I send a kanjak invitation to?
faqs.answer: Send it to the girls' parents, not the girls, and use आप. Give the time, say how long it takes, and when you can, call rather than text, since a parent wants to hear from you before sending a daughter.

faqs.question: Can I send a garba invitation message in Hindi?
faqs.answer: Yes. For one friend or partner, a single line in the तुम register works, such as "[तारीख] की रात [जगह] पर गरबा है, चलोगे?". For a society garba night, use the card format with date, time and venue.

faqs.question: Can I use the Be My Dandiya Partner page for a jagran or kanya pujan?
faqs.answer: No. It is a one-to-one invitation for the one person you want at garba, with nine lines, up to six photos and a 1080×1920 Dandiya Pass. Its interface is in English, so Hindi goes only into the lines you type.

faqs.question: When is Dussehra 2026 for a Ramlila or mela outing?
faqs.answer: Dussehra is Tuesday 20 October 2026 in Delhi and North India, but Wednesday 21 October in Bengal and Mysuru. In 2027 it falls on Saturday 9 October.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Navratri Invitation Message in Hindi for Jagran, Kanjak and Puja

A Navratri invitation message in Hindi has to name five things a greeting skips: the event (चौकी, जागरण, कन्या पूजन), the day and date, a clock time, the address, and a request to reply. We counted the most visible Hindi invitation list in our search on 12 October 2026: 63 messages, and not one carries a time, a date, a place or a named event.

48.3% of pages shared through SubhSandesh are opened on a phone, so each WhatsApp version fits one screen. In Raksha Bandhan 2026, the nearest festival we have measured (n = 89, not Navratri data), 49.4% of pages were built on the festival day itself, so expect late replies. Below are original messages for seven events in Devanagari, romanised Hindi and English, each with a WhatsApp and a card version.

## आप or तुम, सादर or सप्रेम: which Hindi register fits?

Use आप (aap) for elders, neighbours and any family group, and तुम (tum) only for friends, siblings and cousins your own age. McGregor's Oxford Hindi-English Dictionary glosses [तुम as the "reduced hon. grade" of you](https://dsal.uchicago.edu/cgi-bin/app/mcgregor_query.py?qs=%E0%A4%A4%E0%A5%81%E0%A4%AE&searchhws=yes) and आप as the honorific.

The opening phrase follows suit. McGregor defines [सादर as "paying respect, respectful"](https://dsal.uchicago.edu/cgi-bin/app/mcgregor_query.py?qs=%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%A6%E0%A4%B0&searchhws=yes), so सादर आमंत्रण suits a printed card for elders. सप्रेम निमंत्रण ("an invitation, with love") suits close family; सप्रेम is a headword in none of the four DSAL dictionaries we checked, so read it as स + प्रेम ("love").

आमंत्रण and निमंत्रण are near-synonyms: Bahri's learners' dictionary glosses [आमंत्रण as "invitation, call"](https://dsal.uchicago.edu/cgi-bin/app/bahri_query.py?qs=%E0%A4%86%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A4%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%B0%E0%A4%A3&searchhws=yes) and points to निमंत्रण. We leave तू out; it is too intimate for an invitation.

## What should a Hindi Navratri invitation include?

It should state the event and host, day plus date, start time, address with a landmark, and a reply line. On a card, sign off with विनीत (vineet, "humbly") and the family name.

Per [Drik Panchang for New Delhi](https://www.drikpanchang.com/navratri/ashwin-shardiya-navratri-dates.html?geoname-id=1261481&year=2026), Sharad Navratri 2026 runs from Sunday 11 October to Monday 19 October, and Durga Ashtami and Maha Navami both fall on Monday 19 October. Dussehra is Tuesday 20 October in Delhi and North India, but Wednesday 21 October in Bengal and Mysuru.

In 2027 it runs from Thursday 30 September, with Dussehra on Saturday 9 October. Messages below use [brackets] for date, time and address, so they work in any year.

## 7 Hindi Navratri invitation messages, by event

### 1. घटस्थापना (Ghatasthapana, day one)

- Suits: close family, first morning, at your panchang's muhurat.
- जय माता दी। [दिन, तारीख] को सुबह [मुहूर्त] बजे हमारे घर घटस्थापना है। सपरिवार आइए। पता: [पता]। आ पाएँ तो एक लाइन लिख दीजिए।
- *Jai Mata Di. [din, tareekh] ko subah [muhurat] baje hamare ghar ghatasthapana hai. Saparivaar aaiye. Pata: [pata]. Aa paayein to ek line likh dijiye.*
- English: Ghatasthapana at our home, [day, date], [muhurat]. Come with family; tell us if you can.
- Card: **॥ जय माता दी ॥ शारदीय नवरात्रि के प्रथम दिवस पर हमारे निवास पर कलश स्थापना है। आप सपरिवार सादर आमंत्रित हैं। दिनांक: [ ] · मुहूर्त: [ ] · स्थान: [ ] · विनीत: [परिवार]** (Kalash sthapana on day one; your family is respectfully invited.)

### 2. माता की चौकी (Mata ki Chowki)

Suits: neighbours and relatives, one evening. Pamela Lothspeich translates चौकी as the Goddess's "platform-altar" and quotes a Bareilly priest saying chowkis and jagrans have become [especially popular at Navratri](https://cdr.lib.unc.edu/concern/articles/pk02cn56t).

- जय माता दी! [दिन, तारीख] को शाम [समय] बजे से हमारे घर माता की चौकी है। भजन, आरती, फिर भंडारा। पता: [पता]। कितने लोग आएँगे, बता दीजिए ताकि प्रसाद का अंदाज़ा रहे।
- *Jai Mata Di! [din, tareekh] ko shaam [samay] baje se hamare ghar Mata ki Chowki hai. Bhajan, aarti, phir bhandara. Pata: [pata]. Kitne log aayenge, bata dijiye taaki prasad ka andaaza rahe.*
- English: Mata ki Chowki at our home, [day, date], from [time]: bhajans, aarti, bhandara. Tell us your headcount for the prasad.
- Card: **॥ जय माता दी ॥ माँ भगवती की कृपा से हमारे निवास पर माता की चौकी का आयोजन है। आप सपरिवार पधारकर माँ का आशीर्वाद लें। दिनांक: [ ] · समय: सायं [ ] से · भंडारा: आरती के बाद** (A chowki at our home; come with family for her blessing.)

### 3. माता का जागरण / जगराता (all-night jagran)

Suits: the whole lane or society. Lothspeich glosses jagran as "the Mother's vigil"; McGregor gives जागरण as "wakefulness" and "vigil". Guests stay up all night, so say when it starts and which aarti ends it.

- जय माता दी! [दिन, तारीख] की रात [समय] बजे से सुबह की आरती तक [जगह] पर माता का जागरण है। पूरी रात न रुक सकें तो [समय] की आरती तक ज़रूर आइए।
- *Jai Mata Di! [din, tareekh] ki raat [samay] baje se subah ki aarti tak [jagah] par Mata ka jagran hai. Poori raat na ruk sakein to [samay] ki aarti tak zaroor aaiye.*
- English: Jagran at [place], [day, date], from [time] to the morning aarti. If not all night, come for the [time] aarti.
- Card: **॥ जय माता दी ॥ विशाल जागरण का आयोजन किया जा रहा है। रात्रि [ ] बजे से प्रातः आरती तक। स्थान: [ ] · भजन मंडली: [ ] · आप सपरिवार सादर आमंत्रित हैं।** (Night to dawn aarti; respectfully invited.)

### 4. कन्या पूजन / कंजक (Ashtami or Navami)

Suits: the girls' parents, never the girls. Families pick Ashtami or Navami by custom; the Uttarakhand Governor's household [performed Kanya Pujan on Ashtami](https://governoruk.gov.in/?p=52625) on 30 September 2025.

In 2026 the choice disappears in Delhi: both tithis fall on Monday 19 October, Sandhi Puja 10:27–11:15 AM in New Delhi. In 2027 they split (7 and 8 October). A US-timezone panchang shows Ashtami on 18 October 2026, so check locally abroad.

- नमस्ते [नाम] जी, [दिन, तारीख] को सुबह [समय] बजे हमारे घर कन्या पूजन है। [बिटिया का नाम] को भेज दीजिए, आधे घंटे में घर छोड़ देंगे। आ पाएगी तो बता दीजिए।
- *Namaste [naam] ji, [din, tareekh] ko subah [samay] baje hamare ghar kanya pujan hai. [bitiya ka naam] ko bhej dijiye, aadhe ghante mein ghar chhod denge. Aa paayegi to bata dijiye.*
- English: Kanya pujan at ours, [day, date], [time]. Please send [daughter's name]; she'll be home within half an hour.
- Card: **॥ जय माता दी ॥ दुर्गा [अष्टमी/नवमी] के पावन अवसर पर हमारे घर कन्या पूजन है। आपकी बिटिया को देवी रूप में आमंत्रित करते हुए हमें हर्ष है। दिनांक: [ ] · समय: प्रातः [ ]** (We invite your daughter as the Devi.)

### 5. कीर्तन / भजन संध्या (kirtan or bhajan evening)

- Suits: a women's satsang group or neighbours, one afternoon.
- जय माता दी बहनों! [दिन] को दोपहर [समय] बजे हमारे घर नवरात्रि कीर्तन है। ढोलक हमारे पास है, आप अपना पसंदीदा एक भजन लेकर आइए। पता: [पता]।
- *Jai Mata Di behnon! [din] ko dopahar [samay] baje hamare ghar Navratri kirtan hai. Dholak hamare paas hai, aap apna pasandeeda ek bhajan lekar aaiye. Pata: [pata].*
- English: Navratri kirtan at ours, [day], [time]. We have the dholak; bring one bhajan to lead.
- Card: **सादर निमंत्रण · नवरात्रि भजन संध्या · दिनांक: [ ] · समय: [ ] से [ ] · स्थान: [ ]** (A bhajan evening, respectfully.)

### 6. रामलीला या दशहरा मेला (Ramlila or Dussehra mela outing)

Suits: friends (तुम) or the family group (आप). Lothspeich estimates one Ramlila per 150,000–200,000 people in Uttar Pradesh, run over ten to fifteen evenings, with finales above 100,000 people at many venues. Name a gate.

- इस बार रामलीला साथ देखें? [दिन] शाम [समय] बजे [मैदान] के [गेट नंबर] पर मिलते हैं। दशहरे पर रावण दहन भी साथ चलेंगे। चलोगे?
- *Is baar Ramlila saath dekhein? [din] shaam [samay] baje [maidan] ke [gate number] par milte hain. Dussehre par Ravan dahan bhi saath chalenge. Chaloge?*
- English: Ramlila together? [Gate], [ground], [time], [day]; Ravan dahan on Dussehra too?
- Card: none needed. For elders, write चलेंगे आप? and add a pick-up time.

### 7. One garba-night line

Suits: the one person you want at garba. Use तुम.

- [तारीख] की रात [जगह] पर गरबा है, नौ में से एक रात तो साथ नाचो। चलोगे?
- *[tareekh] ki raat [jagah] par garba hai, nau mein se ek raat to saath naacho. Chaloge?* (Garba on [date]: dance one of nine nights with me?)

## WhatsApp or card: which format fits each event?

Five events by India date (Drik Panchang, New Delhi), with the format and register that work. Bigger guest list, more card; smaller list, more personal call.

| Event | India, 2026 | India, 2027 | Best format and register |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ghatasthapana | Sun 11 Oct | Thu 30 Sep | WhatsApp, आप |
| Mata ki Chowki | An evening, 11–19 Oct | An evening, 30 Sep–8 Oct | WhatsApp + card image, आप |
| Jagran | A night, 11–19 Oct | A night, 30 Sep–8 Oct | Printed card + group post, सादर |
| Kanya pujan | Mon 19 Oct (both tithis) | Thu 7 or Fri 8 Oct | Call or message parents, आप |
| Ramlila outing | To Tue 20 Oct (Delhi) | To Sat 9 Oct | WhatsApp, तुम |

## Where the Be My Dandiya Partner page fits, and where it does not

The [Be My Dandiya Partner page](https://subhsandesh.in/dandiya-partner) is the wrong tool for a jagran, chowki or kanya pujan. It is a one-to-one invitation for the single person you want at garba: partner, crush, or best friend as garba buddy.

It holds nine short lines, one per night, and up to six photos; they answer "Will you be my Dandiya partner?" and get a 1080×1920 Dandiya Pass. Its interface is in English, so your Hindi goes into the lines you type.

For a Ramlila or Dussehra mela with one person, a [date invitation page](https://subhsandesh.in/date-invitation) fits better: it asks about a plan, not a dance. Otherwise, [browse all templates](https://subhsandesh.in/templates).

## When a Hindi WhatsApp invitation is the wrong choice

WhatsApp is wrong for grandparents who do not read messages, and for kanjak, where a mother wants to hear your voice before sending her daughter. Call them.

Do not lock a group invitation. 38.5% of SubhSandesh creators password-protect their page, which suits a private note, but a jagran invite must forward freely. And since 49.4% of Raksha Bandhan 2026 pages were built on the day itself, people plan late: follow any card with a one-line reminder that morning.
